goal.label: {action} {object}
goal.host_reboot: restart the machine Home Assistant runs on
goal.host_shutdown: shut down the machine Home Assistant runs on
goal.zigbee_remove_block: remove {object} from the network and block it
goal.zigbee_remove_force_block: remove {object} from Zigbee2MQTT only and block it
goal.zigbee_permit: let new devices join the Zigbee network for {duration}
goal.zigbee_permit_via: let new devices join Zigbee through {object} for {duration}
goal.zigbee_permit_off: turn joining off, so no new devices can join the Zigbee network
everyday.uninstall: its settings and data are deleted
everyday.uninstall_config: its settings, data, and config folder are deleted
everyday.zigbee.new_name_ha: its new name is {to}, and its entity IDs in Home Assistant change too, so automations and dashboards that use the old ones need updating
everyday.zigbee.blocked: it can't rejoin until it is unblocked in Zigbee2MQTT
everyday.zigbee.force_kept: until it is factory reset, it keeps the network key and can still talk on the network
everyday.zigbee.force_blocked: Zigbee2MQTT turns it away if it joins again, but until it is factory reset, it keeps the network key and can still talk on the network
everyday.host_shutdown: Home Assistant stays off until someone turns the machine on again
everyday.zigbee.invert_cover_off: open and closed are no longer swapped

everyday.zigbee.occupancy_timeout.one: it reports no motion {count} second after the last motion
everyday.zigbee.occupancy_timeout.other: it reports no motion {count} seconds after the last motion

raw.steps_intro: I'm about to do these {count} steps in Home Assistant, in this order:

raw.copy_first.one: HA NOVA saves a copy first ({names}).

raw.noun.label: label
raw.object.file: the file {path} in the config folder
raw.object.prune: automatic config copies older than {days} days or beyond the newest {files}; named copies are kept
raw.object.prune_named: automatic config copies older than {days} days or beyond the newest {files}, named copies too
raw.object.prune_in: automatic config copies older than {days} days or beyond the newest {files} in {category}; named copies are kept
raw.object.prune_in_named: automatic config copies older than {days} days or beyond the newest {files} in {category}, named copies too
raw.object.integration_all: the integration {entry} and all its devices and entities
raw.object.subentry_all: the subentry {subentry} of the integration {entry} and its devices and entities
raw.object.expose_new: new entities to the voice assistant {assistant} automatically
raw.object.import: 0 rows into the long-term statistic {statistic} (stored rows for the same hours are overwritten)

raw.object.import_span.other: {count} rows into the long-term statistic {statistic} from {first} to {last} (stored rows for the same hours are overwritten)

raw.object.sharing: what Home Assistant shares about this installation
raw.object.repair_continue: the repair in progress (this can finish it)
raw.object.setup_continue: the setup in progress (this can finish it)
raw.object.repair_step: the next step of the repair in progress
raw.object.subentry_step: the next step of the integration subentry in progress
raw.object.setup_step: the next step of the setup in progress
raw.object.setup_step_of: the next step of the setup of {handler} in progress
raw.note.polling: {object}; changing polling reloads this integration when loaded, briefly making its devices and entities unavailable
raw.note.retention: {object}; automatic backups beyond the retention are deleted for good (by days within a day, by copies after the next automatic backup)
raw.ws.backup_saved_settings: a backup with the saved settings{targets}
raw.ws.hacs_custom: from HACS's list of custom repositories{targets}
raw.ws.hacs_beta: or hide beta releases in HACS of{targets}
raw.ws.todo_item: an item in the to-do list{targets}
raw.field.name: name {name}
raw.event.from_date: {event}: the one on {date} and every later one
raw.event.from_one: {event}: one occurrence and every later one
raw.why.delete: This deletes something in Home Assistant
raw.why.account_create: This creates a Home Assistant account
raw.why.hacs_install: This installs code from HACS that runs in Home Assistant
raw.why.resource_create: This adds code that runs in every browser signed in to Home Assistant
raw.why.resource_update: This changes code that runs in every browser signed in to Home Assistant
raw.why.labs: This turns an experimental Home Assistant feature on or off
raw.why.statistics_import: This writes long-term statistics; rows already stored for the same hours are overwritten
raw.why.energy_emptied: This empties a list of the Energy dashboard or drops several of its entries
raw.why.access_entity: This carries a new ID, area, or label onto a lock, alarm panel, or door, which can change what an automation that opens it targets
raw.why.access_device: This carries a new area or label onto a device with a lock, alarm panel, or door, which can change what an automation that opens it targets
raw.why.person_follows: This changes which devices a person follows, and an unlock or disarm may wait for that person
raw.why.account_access: This changes what a Home Assistant account may do, or whether it can sign in
raw.why.backup_retention: This changes how many automatic backups Home Assistant keeps, and older ones are deleted for good
raw.why.core_clock: This changes Home Assistant's time zone or units, which shifts how history and long-term statistics read
raw.why.core_language: This changes Home Assistant's language, which every later HA NOVA confirmation speaks
raw.why.integration_remove: This removes an integration and its devices from Home Assistant
raw.why.file_delete: This deletes a file in Home Assistant's config folder
raw.why.copy_delete: This deletes a saved config copy
raw.why.skill_typed: This step needs your own confirmation, as the skill asks
raw.why.app_install: This installs an App: new code that runs on your Home Assistant host
raw.why.app_uninstall: This removes an App, and whatever it serves stops working
raw.why.app_settings: This changes an App's settings, which can hold passwords and run code

reason.switch_as_x_maybe: {subject} may work a lock or a door
reason.owned: This {action}, which HA NOVA can't check
reason.owned_also: This also {action}, which HA NOVA can't check
reason.config_delete: This removes it from Home Assistant
reason.many: This acts on {count} devices at once
reason.picked_area: HA NOVA picked it from the area you named
reason.picked_device: HA NOVA picked it from the device you named
reason.picked_group: HA NOVA picked it from the group you named
reason.own_steps: Running it starts its own steps
reason.no_registry: HA NOVA can't see all details of {name}
reason.scene_unread: HA NOVA can't see what the scene {name} changes
reason.listener: Something else may react to this that HA NOVA can't see
reason.integration_service: This runs an integration's own service, which HA NOVA can't fully check
reason.service_not_found: A step calls {service}, which Home Assistant doesn't have: that step will fail when it runs
reason.hacs_install: This installs code from HACS that runs in Home Assistant
reason.unknown: HA NOVA can't fully check this
noun.cover_maybe: a cover that may be a door, gate, or garage
noun.wipe_button: a button that can wipe a device's settings
noun.restart_button: a button that restarts a device
noun.update_button: a button that starts a device update
noun.off_button: a button that switches a device off
noun.reset_button: a reset button (HA NOVA can't tell what it resets)
sibling.switching_unlock: switching it on may unlock it
sibling.switching_disarm: switching it on may disarm it
sibling.switching_open: switching it on may open it
sibling.opening_open: opening it may also open it

owned.mqtt_line: goes straight to a device or bridge
owned.assist: sends a sentence to Assist that can control any device it understands

owned.host_shutdown: shuts down the machine Home Assistant runs on
owned.host_reboot: restarts the machine Home Assistant runs on
owned.restore: restores a backup over the current setup
owned.app: starts, stops, or changes an App
effect.persistent_notification: shows or clears a notification in Home Assistant
effect.logger: changes how much Home Assistant logs
unseen.all: HA NOVA can't check everything this would set off
unseen.all_via: HA NOVA can't check everything {via} would set off
unseen.what: HA NOVA can't see what {name} does
unseen.how: HA NOVA can't check how {name} works

unseen.how_via: {via} uses {name}, and HA NOVA can't check how that works

batch.head.other: I'm about to make these {count} changes in Home Assistant, in this order:

batch.unchecked: HA NOVA can't fully check what this would do.

batch.needs_you.other: One confirmation covers all {count}, so I need you to confirm it.

batch.copies: A copy of each one deleted is saved first, so it can be restored.
batch.no_copies: No copies could be saved, so once deleted they can't be restored.
batch.order: HA NOVA checks each one again right before it is sent and stops at the first one that doesn't go through.

batch.ask.other: Save all {count}? I can also show the details.

batch.phone.either.mixed.other: Change or delete {count} automations and scripts

batch.result.done.other: Done: all {count} went through. I checked each one.

batch.result.no_copies: No copies were saved, as you chose.

batch.result.failed.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; Home Assistant refused {name}.

batch.result.unverified.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; {name} was sent, but the check after it didn't pass.

batch.result.changed.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; {name} changed since you saw it, so I stopped.

batch.result.not_sent.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; {name} couldn't be sent.

batch.result.unknown.other: Not sure: {done} of {count} went through, and {name} may have too; I can't tell. I didn't try again.

batch.result.none_failed: Not done: Home Assistant refused {name}. Nothing changed.
batch.result.none_unverified: Not sure: {name} was sent, but the check after it didn't pass.
batch.result.none_unknown: Not sure: {name} may have gone through, and I can't tell. I didn't try again.

batch.drift.other: Not done: {names} changed since you saw the list, so nothing was sent.
